title: Development of a risk model to predict prognosis in breast cancer based on cGAS-STING-related genes
summary: A model based on 11 cGAS-STING-related genes stratified overall survival across breast-cancer expression cohorts. The reported associations are retrospective prognostic signals and do not establish causal biology or clinical utility. The result remains bounded to the reported datasets and assays.

evidence.tested: A model based on 11 cGAS-STING-related genes stratified overall survival across breast-cancer expression cohorts. The reported associations are retrospective prognostic signals and do not establish causal biology or clinical utility.
evidence.unknown: The source-checked evidence does not establish broader external validity or prospective benefit. Affiliation was not available in the retrieved trusted primary metadata.
